_comment: Deterministic pricing policy. pricing.py computes every number from this file; the AI never invents or recomputes a figure. A new pricing rule is an edit here, not a code change.

seat_overage.reason: sustained active-seat usage above the contracted seat count

usage_tier_crossing.reason: monthly API volume crossed and stayed above the 1M-call tier this year

promo_expiry.reason: expiry of first-year promotional pricing; the renewal price returns toward the standard list rate for the plan

volume_band.reason: volume band pricing for 700+ committed seats on a 36-month term

multi_year_lock.reason: price locked by the multi-year agreement; this renewal confirms the existing rate

caps.reason_when_capped: total adjustment capped by policy at 15%

approval_gate.rationale: any increase above 8%, any price-driven annual delta above $5,000, or any priced change on a churn-risk account is reviewed by a human before it can leave the building

skip_rules.reason: open billing dispute; renewal paperwork is held until the dispute closes
usage data is missing, so an account-specific notice cannot be honestly written; held for data backfill
renewal date is outside the run window; the account belongs to a later batch
